hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/Platform" && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1; } && echo 'Brew Helper: Platform dependencies ready (npm run release:check to verify).' || echo 'Brew Helper: npm ci failed in Platform/; run it manually.'
